senses.gloss: m. pl.(b. h.; cmp. סָעִיף) [ramifications,] שַׂרְעַפֵּי לֵב thoughts, doubts of the heart.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:3-4">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> <he>והיה … משמרו מכל רע ומכל ש׳ לב</he> and the Sabbath day guarded him from all evil and from all doubts of the heart; ed. Bub. <cite ref="O01657"><he>סַרְעַפֵּי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 20">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XX</cite> <he>ומנחמו מכל ס׳ לבו</he> and comforted (relieved) him of &c.
